rules.statement: A candidate containing any Broken entry is not published, and the head does not move.
guards: control:PublishCompileTest
control:ControlFailClosedTest

rules.statement: The revision record is written before the head, and the head carries its parent.
guards: control:RevisionsTest
cocache:RevisionChainTest

rules.statement: simulate, explain and analyze call the same Engine.evaluate as enforcement, and explanations are built by the enforcing flow.
guards: control:ControlPlaneTest#simulate decides with the enforcing flow and shows only what the caller may read
control:ControlPlaneTest#explain decides at the revisions an audit event recorded

rules.statement: A head is replaced only over the digest of the base it was published on; a stale base conflicts, nothing is overwritten and the change is not rebased automatically.
guards: control:RevisionsTest
cocache:RevisionChainTest#two instances publishing on the same base never overwrite each other

rules.statement: A platform or app candidate that removes a policy another document's binding refers to is not published; the back-reference index is added to before a head moves and removed from only after.
guards: control:RevisionsTest

rules.statement: A document has at most one staged change; another stages only once it is published, abandoned or expired.
guards: control:ControlFailClosedTest#one staged change per document
cocache:RevisionChainTest#changes stage one at a time across instances and publish once

rules.statement: Every check of a change is bound to its base: a change whose base moved never publishes, and a rebase runs every check again on the new head.
guards: control:ControlFailClosedTest#a moved base conflicts and publishes nothing, a rebase checks again

rules.statement: Every control-plane write is checked target by target with the control plane's own policies, through the same engine, before anything is recorded: cosec:write on each entry, cosec:grant on each scope a binding grants in, and the step's own action on the document. Anything but a permit refuses it: 403, or 503 when it cannot be decided.
guards: control:ControlAuthorizationTest#nobody writes without the right, and nothing is recorded
control:ControlAuthorizationTest#an undecidable check, a failed confirmation and a failing analysis all refuse

rules.statement: Publishing checks the publisher again on the current heads: their authorization of every target and the grant analysis. What they cannot publish alone waits for approval, and nothing is written.
guards: control:ControlAuthorizationTest#publishing checks the publisher again on the current heads

rules.statement: A staged change's shadow window closes only when the instances' samples that compared (not BASE_MISMATCH) reach the minimum after the minimum duration, or at the maximum duration as insufficient; a change still shadowing never publishes.
guards: control:ShadowWindowTest#two instances sample a window that closes from their reports, and the publisher acknowledges it
control:ShadowWindowTest#a window without enough samples closes at its longest as insufficient

rules.statement: A window that saw WIDENED, NARROWED or BECAME_INDETERMINATE requests, or closed with insufficient samples, publishes only when the publisher acknowledges exactly its window and counts.
guards: control:ShadowWindowTest#two instances sample a window that closes from their reports, and the publisher acknowledges it

rules.statement: A candidate that an instance cannot compile or evaluate (CANDIDATE_ERROR) closes the window at once, and the change never publishes.
guards: control:ShadowWindowTest#a candidate an instance cannot compile closes the window at once and never publishes

rules.statement: Creating or revoking a break-glass binding has no shadow window; any other change skips its window only with cosec:skip-shadow and a recorded reason.
guards: control:ShadowWindowTest#break-glass has no window, and skipping one needs a reason that is recorded

rules.statement: The control plane refuses a tenant policy whose id the platform document already uses (422); the data plane would read such an id as ambiguous unless both contents are the same.
guards: control:PublishCompileTest

rules.statement: Every step that names a change answers a caller who may not read its document exactly as it answers for a change that does not exist (404), before the change's state is looked at.
guards: control:ControlReviewFixesTest#a change another tenant may not read is the same 404 at every step, before its state
control:ControlHttpTest#a body kind is refused, and another tenant's change answers like a missing one

rules.source: RFC 0007 §6.4; round-2 review R1 and its review
rules.statement: A shadow window's numbers are the sum of one report per instance, each that instance's latest cumulative report: an instance's report replaces only its own. A second report of one instance, a report of another window, a negative count, or no report from an instance seen reporting on the window keeps it open instead of being counted, and one instance's CANDIDATE_ERROR blocks the window by itself.
guards: control:ControlRoundTwoFixesTest#a window sums one report per instance, and anything else keeps it open
cocache:CoCacheShadowTest#each instance's report has its own key, and one under another's key is not counted
control:ControlRoundTwoFixesTest#an instance seen reporting on a window must keep reporting until it closes

rules.statement: When whether the caller may read a change cannot be decided (a store or snapshot read fails), every step that names it is a 503, for a change that exists and for one that does not; 404 stays for a change that does not exist or that the caller may not read.
guards: control:ControlRoundTwoFixesTest#a change whose readability cannot be decided is a 503 at every step, whether or not it exists

rules.statement: A rollback needs cosec:read on its document before it says whether a revision exists or shows its entries.
guards: control:ControlRoundTwoFixesTest#a rollback needs cosec read before it says which revisions exist

rules.statement: A document's rate limit rules change only through a change: putRateLimit and removeRateLimit operations, or an :apply whose desired document sets them (all of them with REPLACE). A change that names no rate limit keeps the head's rules as they are.
guards: control:OperationsTest#rate limits are put, removed and diffed

rules.statement: The control plane checks a candidate's conditions against the external attributes the platform declares and, after them, those the host's attribute providers declare, as an instance compiles it: a condition on a provider's attribute is checked clean, one on an attribute neither declares does not compile.
guards: control:ProviderAttributesTest#a candidate compiles against the platform's and the providers' attributes

rules.statement: The control plane refuses a platform policy whose id a tenant document already defines or binds (422), naming those documents, confirmed by reading their heads; a tenant that only defines the id never keeps the platform from removing its own policy of that id.
guards: control:ChangesTest#the platform cannot add an id a tenant uses, and one that only defines it never blocks a removal - RC1-9
